confidence_explanation: The timeline shows a clear pattern of an insider threat (user_10) transitioning from normal file reading to a massive, multi-departmental data exfiltration event during off-hours. The user accessed directories outside their baseline (engineering/shared, devops/runbooks, and security) and downloaded multiple sensitive files in a single session.

attack_chain.description: Initial reconnaissance/access to a directory outside the user's normal scope (/data/shared/project_beta/).
Access to engineering/devops runbooks outside normal scope.
Commencement of bulk data exfiltration during off-hours (19:44).
Exfiltration of finance department files during off-hours.
Exfiltration of security department configuration files during off-hours.

gaps: Lack of information regarding whether user_10 had a legitimate business reason or an approved ticket for accessing security and engineering directories.
No information on whether the downloaded files were subsequently moved to an external location or cloud storage.
narrative: User_10, an executive, exhibited a pattern of escalating unauthorized access, moving from reading files in shared directories to a concentrated exfiltration of sensitive data from the finance, security, and engineering departments. This activity occurred during off-hours (between 18:20 and 22:44) and involved downloading multiple files across departments that are not within their normal directory baseline.
